Controls: TLS to example.com OK (115/120 ms); TLS to Dukascopy's own Cloudflare IP with non-Dukascopy SNI OK. The failure is therefore URL-independent and hostname-keyed (SNI/Host filtered on the network path). Running the full 200-probe grid against a filtering middlebox with requests known to be reset would violate the frozen no-escalation etiquette; each grid cell is recorded UNREACHABLE_TRANSPORT with the representative probes as class evidence.
